name: SheepState
meaning: sheep+0x106; row index of g_sheepStateTable (anim in brackets). 0x15,0x1A,0x24 have no Update case.

name: SHEEP_ST_SLEEP
meaning: [0, model 1] sleepy prop or msg 0x983; snore sfx 0x112

name: SHEEP_ST_ATTR_LOOK
meaning: [3] re-evaluate attractor, dispatch on kind at anim end

name: SHEEP_ST_SCENT_SNIFF
meaning: [0] sniff, claim scent if nearest sheep

name: SHEEP_ST_EAT
meaning: [2] eating salad: msg 1 each frame, sfx 0x3D

name: SHEEP_ST_RETURN_HOME
meaning: [6] in-zone sheep walks back to homePos

name: SHEEP_ST_ATTR_WALK_FAR
meaning: [6] walk toward next food until within 600

name: SHEEP_ST_DIE_FALL
meaning: [8] death-zone fall to fallLimitY, restart fade 0x1000

name: SHEEP_ST_LEAVE_REPEL_BOX
meaning: [6] walk out of SHEEPREPELBOX after 0x5000 ticks inside

name: SHEEP_ST_WALK_TO_POINT
meaning: [6] msg 0x981 from Wolf; on arrival/timeout sends Wolf msg 0x406

name: SHEEP_ST_LAUNCHED
meaning: entered on msg 0xC MSG_LAUNCH (bull toss or seesaw launch), not from SensibleButton

name: SHEEP_ST_FROZEN_FLOAT
meaning: [27] ice cube rising/floating; restart after 0x14000 if not river cargo

name: SHEEP_ST_FROZEN_REST
meaning: [27] ice cube on ground; msg 0x41 thaws
